verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas documents a comprehensive Editor API reference (playcanvas-docs-9, playcanvas-docs-30) and separately offers 12 runnable starter projects via create-playcanvas (playcanvas-docs-1, playcanvas-gh-4), but no evidence shows these are combined into an interactive API reference page with embedded runnable code examples. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of live/interactive code examples embedded in the API reference itself, and any independent confirmation of such a feature.
